name: Lushoto to Irente viewpoint
why: Through farms and forest of the Usambara Mountains to a cliff edge 1,000 m above the Maasai plains.
book: Village fee; local guides from the Lushoto tourist office.
water: A farm sells cheese, bread and drinks on the way.

points.name: Lushoto
points.note: An old German hill station in the Usambara mountains.

points.name: Irente Viewpoint
points.note: A rock edge over the plains far below.
